elements.element: Expiry or termination of the Agreement triggers the exit obligations.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement" and therefore includes both required triggers.

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: IBM must, at Customer's request, "provide transition assistance." This gives Customer the required assistance right when requested.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides assistance "for up to six (6) months."

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires return of "Content," not "Customer Data," and no definition or other operative language establishes that Content includes all Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: A 30-day deadline applies to Content, but the clause does not impose that deadline on Customer Data or establish that Content is coextensive with Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format applies only to Content; no operative language demonstrates that all Customer Data is covered.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: IBM must delete Content after return, but there is no operative duty to delete Customer Data as such or evidence that Content encompasses it.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Written certification is required for deletion of Content, not Customer Data, and the supplied language does not equate those terms.

elements.element: Expiry or termination of the Agreement triggers the fallback exit obligations.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph expressly applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: IBM is obligated to provide transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which encompasses and exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause returns "Content," and no supplied operative definition establishes that this is the Customer Data covered by the fallback.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported or returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day deadline applies only to Content; coverage of Customer Data is not established.

result.reason: Neither level is complete because the operative data duties cover "Content" rather than Customer Data, with no supplied definition showing equivalence; the margin comment cannot cure that omission. The redline also extends the obligations to termination or expiry of any individual Service Option Attachment and then requires return and deletion of all Content. That scope is broader than necessary and could require deletion of Content used under other continuing attachments, undermining the original clause's treatment of independently continuing attachments. The assistance language otherwise meets both the six-month preferred position and the 90-day fallback.
